classification.difficultyReason: Relates qualitative changes in speed over a lap to the positions and sharpness of bends in a circuit.

content.prompt: A racing car travels around the three circuits shown. At sharp turns, the car must slow down. The graphs below show the speed of the car on the second lap of each of these circuits. Match each graph with a circuit.

spec.description: Tall narrow oval, with S on the upper-right side and a downward direction arrow below S.
spec.mathematics: Closed circuit with two separated tighter bends at its ends; no numerical dimensions or scale.
spec.answerVisibility: No matching answer appears in the question diagram.

spec.description: Approximately circular circuit, with S on the upper-right side and a downward direction arrow below S.
spec.mathematics: Closed circular circuit with uniform curvature; no numerical dimensions or scale.
spec.answerVisibility: No matching answer appears in the question diagram.

spec.description: Asymmetric elongated closed circuit rising diagonally from a tight lower-left bend to a rounded upper-right end. S lies on the left side near the lower-left bend; the direction arrow above S points upwards and right.
spec.mathematics: Qualitative circuit outline only; no numerical geometry is asserted. The visible outline does not clearly establish the three slowdowns in its supplied matching graph.
spec.answerVisibility: No matching answer appears in the question diagram.

spec.description: Graph A: positive baseline with two nearby shallow early dips and one deeper later dip, returning to the baseline after each. Eight grid columns and six rows; arrowed axes labelled Speed and Distance from start.
spec.mathematics: Qualitative speed versus distance graph without numerical ticks. Three distinct slowdowns, the last substantially greater.
spec.answerVisibility: Graph label A is a supplied option; matching answers are hidden.

spec.description: Graph B: positive horizontal speed line throughout. Eight grid columns and six rows; arrowed axes labelled Speed and Distance from start.
spec.mathematics: Constant positive speed over the lap; no numerical scale.
spec.answerVisibility: Graph label B is a supplied option; matching answers are hidden.

spec.description: Graph C: positive baseline interrupted by two separated shallow dips of approximately equal depth. Eight grid columns and six rows; arrowed axes labelled Speed and Distance from start.
spec.mathematics: Two separated slowdowns of similar magnitude over the lap; no numerical scale.
spec.answerVisibility: Graph label C is a supplied option; matching answers are hidden.

answer.short: i – C, ii – B, iii – A.
answer.worked:
i – C: the two tighter ends of the oval produce two similar slowdowns.
ii – B: the circular circuit has uniform curvature, so the speed stays constant.
iii – A: this is the supplied remaining match. Graph A shows two small slowdowns followed by one larger slowdown; these three bends are not clearly identifiable in the supplied circuit outline.
